title: Silvercloud: Conversation with a Digital Health Founder
body_html: Ken Cahill is the founder of SilverCloud, among the most serious of the digital health companies in the world of mental health (or, as we might have it, the medical discipline of psychiatry). He joined us on Clubhouse to discuss the world of digital health companies and the role of partnership with clinical entities in getting the needle moving on actual outcomes. Join us for the podcastified version of the social audio programing!
